author: Tryhaard
body:
Hi, Greetings Avicus Staff, today about an hour ago i had a temporary ban for combat logging, but i want to ask if i can get banned with just one warn of combat logging. Most people get banned at the 3rd Warn and i dont think that is fair that i get banned with just 1 warning. Here some proves of my first and only kick for logging out in combat. http://gyazo.com/1f54514d407dcfe2cfaf27c80af2f78f
 
Spanish: Hola, buenos días staff de Avicus, hoy hace 1 hora me dieron un temp-ban por unos días, por hacer combat log, pero yo quería preguntar si es justo que me pongan un tempban con una sola advertencia de combat log, a la mayoría de personas se le pone el temp ban a la tercera advertencia, pruebas de mi único kick por combat log,   http://gyazo.com/1f54514d407dcfe2cfaf27c80af2f78f
 
Translated by... one friend
